result_text:
Added `analyzeLandscape` as a second name for `updateLandscape`, but I could not run it: the sandbox blocked `java` and `git diff` with an approval prompt, so I checked the change by reading the code.

**Changes (all in `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/`):**
- `Commands.java`: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` constant and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is added to the no-argument usage overview, right after `updateLandscape`, using the same landscape options.
- `CommandLineInterface.java`:
  - Dispatch sends `analyzeLandscape` to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so options and behaviour are identical.
  - `-help` now prints the name the user typed (`args[0]`) with the matching description. `updateLandscape -help` prints its own usage as before.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl cli compile` ran without errors and produced fresh classes. No CLI tests exist in the repo, so none were run. Please run `java -jar cli/target/...jar analyzeLandscape -help` and `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` to confirm the behaviour at runtime.

**README:** I left it unchanged. It has no command documentation (only build and Docker notes), so there was nothing to update. The command descriptions the CLI prints live in `Commands.java`. If you want a commands section in the README, I can add one.
